title: Three Ways to Master Marketing in Minutes with REMAX + Canva
summary: Built-in branding, live MLS data and brokerage template sharing make it easier to create professional marketing materials with fewer steps.
body_markdown:
Creating professional marketing materials doesn’t have to be time-consuming.


The REMAX + Canva integration is designed to help agents create branded marketing pieces faster with fewer steps. By combining Canva’s popular design platform with approved REMAX® branding, live MLS data and customizable templates, the integration helps agents spend less time managing marketing tasks and more time serving clients.


For[Tanner Greenwell](https://www.remax.com/usa/en/real-estate-agents/tanner-greenwell-mt-washington-ky/102059176) , managing broker of REMAX Empire in Mt. Washington, Kentucky, that’s where the value becomes clear.


Greenwell creates a steady stream of marketing materials for his office, from property flyers and social media graphics to award announcements and brokerage communications. Before using REMAX + Canva, even simple projects often required moving between multiple systems to find and upload the right assets.


Here, he shares why he believes marketing agent business has never been easier.


**“Brand Assets Are There Waiting”**


“With REMAX + Canva, I love that all of our brand assets are just there waiting for me. Every version of the REMAX logo, Children’s Miracle Network, everything,” Greenwell says. “I don’t have to hunt them down, download them and re-upload them into my own Canva account anymore.”


One of the integration’s biggest advantages is access to REMAX Brand Kits, which provide approved logos, colors and fonts in a centralized location. Instead of searching for assets or wondering whether materials meet brand standards, REMAX agents can design with confidence from the start.


The platform also removes much of the manual work associated with listing marketing. Through live MLS integration, listing photos, pricing and property details can flow directly into templates, reducing data entry and helping agents create marketing materials more efficiently.


**“It’s All Built-In”**


Beyond keeping brand assets in one place, Greenwell says the platform has simplified the day-to-day work of creating marketing materials for both agents and the brokerage.


“I create a lot of graphics for our office, including flyers, social posts, award announcements, and before REMAX + Canva, it took so much longer,” he says. “I was constantly downloading logos from one site, uploading them to another. Now it’s all built in, and it really automates the whole process.”


Agents also don’t have to start from scratch. The REMAX + Canva environment includes a robust library of branded templates that can be customized in minutes, making it easier to create professional-looking materials regardless of an agent’s design experience.


“Inside the REMAX + Canva app there are hundreds of branded templates and assets ready to go,” Greenwell says. “I can just open one, tweak the details and have something professional-looking in minutes.”


**“\[It’s an\] ‘aha’ tool for me”**


For brokerages and teams, the benefits extend beyond individual productivity. Using Brokerage Teams functionality, offices can share templates, organize resources and maintain consistency across agent marketing through a centralized workspace.


The platform is designed to keep marketing resources organized and accessible, helping agents move from idea to finished piece more efficiently. Whether they’re promoting a listing, celebrating a client success story or creating office announcements, agents can spend less time managing design details and more time focusing on their business.


For Greenwell, the biggest benefit isn’t the technology itself. It’s what the technology makes possible.


“REMAX + Canva was one of those ‘aha’ tools for me,” he says. “At first it’s one more thing to learn, but once I realized how much time it saved and how easy it made it to stay on brand, I wondered why I hadn’t been using it sooner.”


That efficiency has a direct impact on how agents spend their time.


“For agents and for our office, REMAX + Canva takes a lot of the friction out of marketing,” Greenwell says. “Instead of getting bogged down in design logistics, you can focus on the message and the client, because the branding is already handled for you.”


As agents look for ways to work more efficiently in a competitive market, tools that save time without sacrificing professionalism can have an outsized impact. For Greenwell, the REMAX + Canva integration delivers exactly that: a simpler way to create polished, on-brand marketing that helps agents focus on what they do best.


*Each REMAX office is independently owned and operated.*
